message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of "TEMPO" magazine. The background is solid red. At the top, white text reads "Liputan Khusus Film Pilihan Tempo 2021 H.92" and "TEMPO" in large serif letters. Below it, smaller letters state "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". A barcode, QR code, and publication details are in the upper right.

Centrally, a stylized pinkish-beige rectangular building sits on a gray surface. It has six arched blue windows and a large red rounded awning over the entrance. A gold-framed luggage cart with a blue platform sits to the left. A person in a red uniform and white mask stands at the entrance. To the right, four small figures flee the building towards the right edge: a person in a blue jacket with a suitcase, a person in a dark suit gesturing, a person in a tan trench coat pulling a silver suitcase, and a person in a blue shirt running.

At the bottom, large black text reads "KARANTINA SUKA-SUKA", followed by three lines of smaller black text starting with "Sejumlah anggota DPR, pesohor, dan orang berduit..." and ending with "H.68".
